key_insight: ANGLE learns the full conditional distribution of angular outcomes with a lightweight generative model, avoiding misleading mean-based regression on circular data.
engineering_relevance: It enables better uncertainty-aware prediction for direction/pose problems in robotics, autonomy, vision, and energy systems where angles are the target output.
method: Generative mapping learns angular responses from Euclidean and circular covariates.
Training uses a generalized circular energy score (GCES) with strict propriety.
Supports pre- and post-additive noise models plus extrapolation, SDR, and distribution-equality testing.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive simulations and real-world evaluations on object pose estimation and wind direction prediction, showing superior predictive performance and uncertainty quantification.
watch_item: Performance depends on correctly modeling circular structure and noise assumptions, so implementation should carefully validate angle wrapping, equivariance, and calibration on each dataset.
paper_title: ANGLE: Angular Neural Generative Learning via Engression
